method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-11-08 reports: The World Bank estimates over 80% of residents in Egypt's 14 major cities are exposed to at least one major climate risk; the Nile Delta is about one metre above mean sea level.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2022-11-08 reports: The report says poor urban residents are more likely to live on hazardous sites or in slums, face higher pollution and congestion, and lack assets or skills to cope with shocks.
